grid.strand: Communication & Literacy (English, FS E2 to L1)
grid.outcomes: Read and respond to a whole text about identity; infer meaning and support with evidence; take part in group discussion; write an accurate, organised paragraph.
grid.activities: Whole-class reader on identity/belonging; inference and reading-journal work; a short 'Who I am' spoken presentation (blends PSHE/Careers); explicit vocabulary and sentence teaching. ICT: word-process and present.
grid.vocab: infer, evidence, identity, paragraph, connective, audience, purpose

grid.qualification: Pearson Functional Skills English Entry 2 to Level 1 (reading, writing, SLC); AQA UAS 'Reading for meaning', 'Spoken presentation'.
grid.assessment: F: baseline reading age & writing screen (Sep); reading-journal checks.  S: assessed presentation + paragraph (Oct) + UAS.
grid.send_smsc: Vocabulary pre-teach, sentence frames, knowledge organisers, reading scaffolds, extended time. SMSC: Int'l Literacy Day, Black History Month.

grid.strand: Communication & Literacy (English, FS E2 to L1)
grid.outcomes: Find explicit and implicit information; compare ideas across non-fiction texts; write a clear, organised information text with accurate punctuation and paragraphs.
grid.activities: Comparative non-fiction reading on community/belonging; formal writing (notice/article) (blends Computing); proofreading and redrafting; persuasive writing (Anti-Bullying Week). ICT: research and word-process.
grid.vocab: explicit, implicit, compare, structure, paragraph, purpose, audience
grid.texts: Paired non-fiction articles; model texts; real-world texts (notices, leaflets)
grid.qualification: Pearson Functional Skills English Entry 3 to Level 1 (reading & writing); AQA UAS 'Writing to inform'.
grid.assessment: F: low-stakes reading quizzes, writing checklists.  S: information text + reading assessment (Dec) + FS/UAS.
grid.send_smsc: Writing frames, spell-check protocols, chunked texts, modelled paragraphs. SMSC: Anti-Bullying Week, Human Rights Day.

grid.strand: Numeracy (Maths, White Rose Year 3/4 + Entry Level)
grid.outcomes: Read, write, represent, order, compare and round numbers to 1000 (stretch 10,000); partition; add and subtract mentally and using column methods with exchange; solve multi-step problems.
grid.activities: WRS Y3/4 place-value and add/sub small steps; CPA with place-value counters; column methods; real-money problems (blends Careers). ICT: spreadsheets for number.
grid.vocab: place value, partition, round, column method, exchange, estimate
grid.texts: WRS Y3/4 units; place-value apparatus; real number & money contexts
grid.qualification: Pearson Entry Level Maths (E1→E3 intro) toward Functional Skills; AQA UAS 'Using number'.
grid.assessment: F: baseline + place-value/calculation checks.  S: number & calculation assessment (Oct) + Entry Level/UAS.
grid.send_smsc: CPA, worked examples, reduced-density worksheets, age-appropriate contexts. SMSC/PfA: financial capability.

grid.strand: Numeracy (Maths, White Rose Year 3/4 + Entry Level)
grid.outcomes: Recall and use 3, 4 and 8 times-table facts; multiply and divide 2-digit numbers by 1-digit using written methods; solve multiplication/division problems; measure and compare area by counting squares.
grid.activities: WRS Y3/4 mult/div small steps; times-table fluency; written methods; area by counting squares. ICT: online times-table tools, data.
grid.vocab: multiply, divide, times-table, written method, area, square
grid.texts: WRS Y3/4 units; arrays and area grids; White Rose materials
grid.qualification: Pearson Entry Level Maths (E1→E3); AQA UAS 'Using number', 'Measuring'.
grid.assessment: F: times-table & method checks.  S: mult/div & area assessment (Dec) + Entry Level/UAS.
grid.send_smsc: Arrays, manipulatives, scaffolded steps. PfA: number for life.

grid.unit: Animals incl. humans: skeletons, movement & nutrition
grid.outcomes: Identify skeletons for support, protection and movement; name major bones; explain how muscles and bones move the body; describe the need for the right nutrition and a balanced diet.

grid.vocab: skeleton, bone, muscle, vertebrate, nutrition, balanced diet
grid.texts: WRS Y3 units; hi-lo body & health texts; model skeleton; food packaging

grid.assessment: F: baseline + labelling & sorting checks.  S: skeletons/nutrition assessment (Oct) + Entry Level/UAS.
grid.send_smsc: Word banks, labelled diagrams, practical over written recording; age-appropriate contexts. SMSC/PfA: health, healthy living.

grid.outcomes: Compare and group rocks by appearance and properties; test hardness and permeability; identify uses of rocks; record results in a table and carry out a simple fair test.

grid.send_smsc: Practical grouping, scaffolded tables, visual prompts. SMSC: sustainability, caring for our world.

cells: Curriculum Pathway Ladder  ·  2026/27

Build → Grow → Launch is a laddered curriculum: every learner has an accessible, accredited next step, and can move up or down a pathway as an individual. Entry Level → Functional Skills → GCSE is the core English/maths/science spine. Each cell shows the pathway's TARGET and, where relevant, the FLOOR for the lowest learners so no one is stranded.
Subject / area
BUILD  (Entry Level)
GROW  (Functional Skills)
LAUNCH  (GCSE)
English / Literacy
Functional Skills Entry 2→Level 1; top-KS2/KS3 reading & writing. TRT catch-up only.
Functional Skills Level 1→Level 2; KS3 reading & writing. Floor: Entry 3 / Step Up to English.
GCSE English Language 8700 (+ optional Literature 8702); FS L1/L2.
Maths / Numeracy
White Rose Year 3/4 mixed-age spine (diagnostic-led; Yr 1–2 gap-fill, Yr 5–6 stretch; age-appropriate); Entry Level Maths E1→E2→E3 ladder; FS E3/L1 stretch.
White Rose Year 5/6 spine (diagnostic-led; Yr 3/4 gap-fill; KS3 for Level 2 stretch); Functional Skills Level 1→Level 2. Floor: Entry 3 / Entry Level.
GCSE Maths 1MA1 (Foundation); FS L1/L2.
Science
White Rose Science Year 3–6 (diagnostic-led; Yr 1–2 gap-fill only; age-appropriate); Entry Level Science 8939 intro.
White Rose Science Year 5/6 spine (diagnostic-led; Yr 3/4 gap-fill; KS3 stretch); Pearson Entry Level Science 8939 (E1→E3). Floor: Entry 1 with support.
Edexcel GCSE Biology 1BI0 / Combined Science (Foundation). Option: full IGCSE Sciences – Biology 4BI1, Chemistry 4CH1 & Physics 4PH1 (eligible students).
Humanities (Hist/Geog)
NC KS1/2 'World About Me'; Kapow History & Geography. Floor: KS1 enquiry.
NC KS2/3 History & Geography (Kapow). Floor: KS2 enquiry.
NC KS3/4; optional GCSE History 8145 / Geography.
Computing & ICT
NC KS1/2 computing; digital literacy; ICT embedded in every subject. Floor: supported device use.
